subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core session process-event contract now, and if so what taxonomy, replay, persistence, authorization, and redaction rules should be the public API?
rationale: The code has adjacent event streams, but choosing `process.*`/`step.*` semantics would create a new stable Gateway/session contract and expose intermediate run state across client boundaries.

options.title: Design core process events first
options.body: Approve a core API design covering taxonomy, stable ids, replay, persistence, authorization, redaction, and client mappings before any implementation PR.

options.title: Narrow to existing streams
options.body: Decline a new taxonomy for now and improve clients against existing lifecycle/item/plan/tool/session.tool streams where sufficient.

options.title: Defer to plugin-only experimentation
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub experiment, accepting that it will not provide a stable upstream session process contract yet.

recommendation.title: Design core process events first
recommendation.body: Approve a core API design covering taxonomy, stable ids, replay, persistence, authorization, redaction, and client mappings before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person on the central agent event and gateway surfaces most directly affected by a new process-event contract.
